meta.name: peft-fine-tuning
meta.description: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning for LLMs using LoRA, QLoRA, and 25+ methods. Use when fine-tuning large models (7B-70B) with limited GPU memory, when you need to train <1% of parameters with minimal accuracy loss, or for multi-adapter serving. HuggingFace's official library integrated with transformers ecosystem.

copy.tagline: 用 LoRA 等方法微调大语言模型，节省 GPU 内存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要在有限 GPU 上微调 7B-70B 参数的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Fine-tune large language models with LoRA and 25+ methods, saving GPU memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to fine-tune 7B-70B models with limited GPU memory

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 LoRA、QLoRA 等方法微调大语言模型（7B-70B），只训练不到 1% 的参数，节省显存和存储空间。
howto.when: 当你需要微调 7B-70B 的大模型，但 GPU 显存有限（如 RTX 4090、A100），或者想为不同任务训练多个轻量适配器时触发。

say.text: 用 LoRA 微调 Llama 3.1 8B 模型，训练 3 个 epoch。
say.note: Claude 会生成 LoRA 微调代码并指导运行。

say.text: 用 QLoRA 在 24GB 显卡上微调 70B 模型。
say.note: Claude 会配置 4-bit 量化并生成训练脚本。

say.text: 加载之前保存的 LoRA 适配器并合并到基础模型。
say.note: Claude 会展示加载和合并适配器的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you fine-tune large language models (7B-70B) using LoRA, QLoRA, and 25+ methods, training less than 1% of parameters to save GPU memory and storage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to fine-tune 7B-70B models with limited GPU memory (e.g., RTX 4090, A100), or when you want to train multiple lightweight adapters for different tasks.

say_en.text: Fine-tune Llama 3.1 8B with LoRA for 3 epochs.
say_en.note: Claude will generate LoRA fine-tuning code and guide you.

say_en.text: Fine-tune a 70B model on a single 24GB GPU using QLoRA.
say_en.note: Claude will configure 4-bit quantization and generate training script.

say_en.text: Load a saved LoRA adapter and merge it into the base model.
say_en.note: Claude will show code to load and merge the adapter.
